Resolves #19851

A reactive config's `beforeSet` hook that rejects by throwing now leaves the previous value in place. The generated setter undoes the temporary state it wrote for the hook, then rethrows the same error. The cancel and transform paths are unchanged, and no `afterSet` runs for a rejected value. This targets `dev`; whether it rides 13.3.0 is @tobiu's call.

Evidence: L1 (engine unit behaviour, no runtime surface beyond the class system) → L1 required (AC-1 to AC-3 are unit behaviour). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/core/ClassSystem.spec.mjs` › `a beforeSet that throws leaves the previous value and runs no afterSet (#19851)`: the `TypeError` is rethrown, the value stays `'good'`, and `afterSet` ran only for the accepted changes, on the assignment path and the batched `set()` path alike |
| AC-2 | The same arm: a cancel keeps the value and a transform applies. The full engine unit tier is green locally and runs in CI |
| AC-3 | Red on dev: with `src/Neo.mjs` at dev the arm fails with `Expected: "good"`, `Received: "bad"`; it passes with the fix |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive.

## Test Evidence
Red-first, local: with only `src/Neo.mjs` stashed back to dev, the new arm fails (`Expected: "good"`, `Received: "bad"`), and with the fix all six class-system tests pass. Everything else runs in CI.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**: In `Base#set(values)` (`src/core/Base.mjs:1099-1108`), `Object.assign(me[configSymbol], values)` stages all keys in `me[configSymbol]` before `me.processConfigs(true)` iterates them one by one. When `beforeSet<Key>` throws on the first key of a multi-key `instance.set({ foo: 'bad', bar: 'queued' })`, `foo` is deleted from `me[configSymbol]` (`src/Neo.mjs:432`) and `me[_foo]` is restored to `oldValue` by this fix, while unvisited sibling keys (`bar`) remain pending in `me[configSymbol]` and will flush if `instance.bar` is later read via the lazy getter (`src/Neo.mjs:402-406`) or on the next `set()` call (`src/core/Base.mjs:1086`). `#19851` explicitly scopes transactional multi-key `set({a, b})` out of this leaf; noting the `me[configSymbol]` staging residual documents the exact seam if transactional batch rollback is ever pursued.

### 🧠 Graph Ingestion Notes

*   **`[RETROSPECTIVE]`**: `Neo.autoGenerateGetSet` (`src/Neo.mjs:446-455`) writes the candidate value to `me[_key]` (`Config#setRaw`) before invoking `me[beforeSet](value, oldValue)` so cross-config reads see the in-flight state; restoring `me[_key] = oldValue` in `catch` before rethrowing preserves the invariant that a rejected `beforeSet` never mutates the backing `Config` value or triggers `afterSet`.
